free_tier.stated: 体验版 (Free): free; a limited trial quota with a 2-week Pro trial and 300 Credits, and limited completions; when Credits are exhausted, a basic model with limited capabilities such as code completion
free_tier.notes: Pro is CNY 59 a month or CNY 637.20 a year with 2,000 Credits a month; Pro+ CNY 169 with 6,000; Ultra CNY 559 with 20,000; a personal add-on pack is CNY 40 for 1,000 Credits, valid one month. At the ECB rates of 2026-10-29 (6.6616 CNY per USD), Pro is about USD 8.86 a month. The free Pro promotion ended on 2026-05-20 at 18:00 Beijing time. Credits are spent per request by mode (about 3 to 4 for Ask, 7 to 12 for Agent, 50 for Quest), so request-count is the nearest metered_on term.

interface_detail: Qoder CN desktop, Qoder CN IDE, the JetBrains plugin, QoderWork CN and Qoder CN CLI share one Credits balance on a personal plan; the CLI runs headless with `qodercn --print` and prints text, JSON or stream JSON
tooling: Qoder CN CLI (`qodercn`), Qoder CN desktop and IDE, the JetBrains plugin; the VS Code plugin is no longer developed
chaining: a separate account system from Qoder International (coding-subs/qoder): Credits and subscriptions do not transfer, and models are domestic (GLM, DeepSeek, Kimi, MiniMax)

limits.value: Free: a 2-week Pro trial with 300 Credits, then a basic model with limited capabilities such as code completion
Pro: 2,000 Credits a month at CNY 59; plan Credits reset on the purchase date each month and do not roll over

binding_note: after the 2-week trial the free plan has only a basic model for completion; the agent allowance is the paid monthly Credits, and buying them needs a real-name verified Alibaba Cloud account

identity_cost.detail: a personal account is an Alibaba Cloud account bound to a mobile number, signed in with an SMS code, and one is created at purchase if the number has none; Alibaba Cloud accounts must complete real-name verification before purchasing; personal plans need the primary account, not a RAM user

reliability_note: the product was renamed from TONGYI Lingma to Qoder CN on 2026-05-20 and moved to Credits pricing the same day; the VS Code plugin is deprecated
confidence_note: the plans, prices, Credits, the rename, the headless CLI and the account and verification requirements are quoted from first-party pages read. Which documents real-name verification accepts and whether a non-Chinese mobile number registers are behind a sign-up and unverified.
